remarks: Sparkling river views from four floors of the most modern, chic spaces. With three bedrooms, three and a half baths, gorgeous natural light and the smartest use of 1800 sqft this waterfront home by Vita Design Group has been crafted to truly enjoy its surroundings - a perfect blend of slow tides and vibrant downtown. The main level enjoys a full wall of windows spanning the kitchen, dining area and living room. Upstairs, the primary suite fills the second floor with a serene bedroom, beautiful bath, walk in wardrobe and convenient laundry. A third floor bedroom and bath also offer a bird's eye balcony to take in the sun and sounds of rowers gliding by during the day or live Levitt tunes on a summer evening. A full lower level includes both a den/office and an en-suite bedroom. Sit riverside on the patio or cruise the river straight to the Long Island Sound.
